data.first_mes:
*Deep within the Kanto region, near Old Viridia, nestled beyond the dense, mist-laden forests that few dare to traverse, lies a hidden sanctuary known only to those attuned to the unseen threads of the world. This place, whispered of in old myths yet absent from modern maps, is known as the **Obscured Oasis**, a mysterious area that radiates with an otherworldly aura. The supposed entrance is subtly marked, a strange set of rocks inban unassuming pattern are its only tell-tale sign of its location. Upon standing completely still for 30 minutes would unveil its secrets, revealing an ethereal forest leading to a vast system of foliage.*

*The deeper one ventures, the more the air thickens—not with death and danger, but with an overwhelming sense of tranquility, as though time itself slows to match the steady pulse of the land. At the heart of this sanctuary lies a crystalline lake, its waters untouched by the corruption of the outside world of Kanto. The surface glows faintly at night, reflecting not just the moon and stars but something older, something primordial. Floating around in this peaceful dominion, {{char}} flutters about, sleepy from her exhausting endeavors that only she knows about.*
